messages:
nisha: Quick check-in 1 pager + 2 social posts + webinar blurb for deploy modes (hosted / dedicated / private). Goal: field-ready one-sheet + inbound routing guidance.
aj: I'll draft the one-pager. Need a conservative SLA blurb from ops before final.
sam: Field request: include a short routing table: high-intent -> Sales Ops, compliance requests -> Security review, trial signups -> SDR. One line each.
emma: I'll draft the exec LinkedIn post and a short product tweet. Want a one-sentence ops quote about failover and fallback policies.
ops-bot: Benchmarks uploaded: /benchmarks/deploy_mode_field_digest.csv. Summary: batching + KV caching yields ~20-30% unit-cost savings depending on model & prompt. Use "up to 30%" with footnote.
aj: Proposed one-pager sections: TL;DR, Mode-at-a-glance, Security & controls, SLA snapshot (3 tiers), Benchmark pullout, Field routing + CTAs, Webinar link + FAQ.
nisha: Field CTA should be "Request a Dedicated Eval" (primary) and "Start a Trial" (secondary). Add intake timeline: form -> security review -> sizing -> 1-2 week pilot -> decision.
sam: I'll compress intake to 3 lines and add expected timeline (2-6 weeks). Also add reviewers: security, infra, legal.
emma: Draft social copy idea: "Ship LLM features where you need them  hosted, reserved, or in your network  backed by enterprise SLAs. Join our webinar." Add webinar CTA.
aj: For benchmark callout use: "Typical 50k tok/day chat  up to 30% unit-cost savings with batching + KV caching. Results vary by model & prompt." ops-bot: Confirmed wording OK.
webinar-bot: Webinar scheduled: "Deploy Modes for Regulated Workloads" 2026-09-10 10:00 PT. Reg: https://events.redwood/dep-modes-2026-09-10
nisha: Aim to have first drafts in drive by tomorrow 09:30 PT. Please drop a :thumbsup: when your copy is uploaded.
aj: Will do.
sam: Will finish field intake copy by EOD.
emma: I'll post social drafts tonight.
